newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers raise ratings on Valeo.
newsitem.headline: Brokers raise ratings on Valeo.

text.p: Brokerage firms raised their recommendations on Valeo on Friday after the car parts supplier reported a 14.6 percent rise in first-half sales to 17.26 billion francs and forecast higher first-half results.
The stock was 3.92 percent higher in late trading at 403.20 francs while the CAC-40 index was fractionally lower.
BNP Equities raised its recommendation to buy from reinforce and set an objective of 440 francs.

Ferri raised its rating to '1' or buy from '2' and set an objective of 425 francs. It said a 10 percent lag in Valeo's price/1998 estimated earnings ratio relative to the market was not justified. -- Paris Newsroom, +33 1 4221 5452
